discussions.title: Welcome to the HPC-DAT community forum
discussions.body:
This forum is a place for researchers to ask practical questions, share scalable workflows, propose ideas, and follow HPC-DAT news.

Before posting, choose the topic that best fits your contribution. Use **Questions and Help** for questions that can have an accepted answer, **Ideas and Feedback** for suggestions, and **Use Cases and Showcases** for workflows or results.

Please follow our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/HPC-DAT/forum/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Include enough context for others to reproduce a technical problem, but never post credentials, access tokens, private data, or sensitive cluster information.

discussions.title: Second user committee meeting, Amsterdam, 10 September 2026
discussions.body:
The second user committee meeting is scheduled for 10 September 2026 in Amsterdam.

We look forward to presenting the project’s initial progress and results and gathering feedback from our broader user community.

discussions.title: Open hackathon: high-performance computing with Python and RS-DAT, Utrecht, 27-29 May 2026
discussions.body:
Get support adopting RS-DAT and developing Dask and PyData skills during this open hackathon in Utrecht.

[Hackathon information](https://www.surf.nl/en/agenda/hackathon-high-performance-computing-with-python-and-rs-dat)

discussions.title: High-performance computing with Python and RS-DAT workshop, Utrecht, 19 March 2026
discussions.body:
Learn how to scale Python data analysis to clusters and supercomputers with RS-DAT, Dask, Jupyter, and PyData tooling.

[Workshop information](https://www.surf.nl/en/agenda/high-performance-computing-with-python-and-rs-dat)

discussions.title: Inaugural HPC-DAT user committee meeting, Amsterdam, 13 February 2026
discussions.body:
The inaugural user committee meeting of the HPC-DAT project took place in Amsterdam on 13 February 2026.

The user committee helps ensure that the training and technical development delivered by HPC-DAT stay aligned with the needs of the scientific community.
